metadata.title: BoRo Studio International Market Intelligence — Top 50
metadata.normalization: Percentile ranks within the 63-economy candidate universe; log transform before percentile for GDP, GDP per capita, population and manufacturing value-added.

score_formula.technology_investment_readiness_20: 20*P(WIPO GII 2025 score or documented equivalent proxy)
score_formula.icp_density_proxy_20: 9*P(log implied population) + 7*P(log manufacturing value added) + 4*P(log GDP nominal)
score_formula.gtm_ease_10: 4*language access + 3*time-zone overlap with Santiago + 3*B2B-email legal access

important_method_notes: Technology spending is not fabricated when country-level public data are unavailable. WIPO/S&P software spending % GDP is stored where observed but not forced into the score because coverage/modeling is uneven.
The technology sub-score is therefore best read as technology investment/readiness, not literal total IT-spend dollars.
ICP density is a transparent cross-country proxy; national sector/business-register anchors are preferred for market deep dives.
Competition is reported as an inference and is deliberately not penalized in the score: high competition may be evidence of strong demand.
GTM legal-access values are simplified scoring inputs, not legal advice. Actual campaigns require country-specific compliance review.
Ireland GDP per capita is distorted upward by multinational accounting; GNI* sensitivity should be added before committing a large budget.
TAM/SAM/SOM are ranges intended for market-screening, not forecasts of bookings.

fact_type_legend.ESTIMATE: derived range or modeled market count
fact_type_legend.PROXY: observable surrogate for missing comparable measure

IMF_WEO_2026_04.title: IMF World Economic Outlook Database — April 2026
IMF_WEO_2026_04.note: Cross-country macro vintage frozen to April 2026 for comparability; later July 2026 update is a sensitivity source.

WIPO_GII_2025.title: WIPO Global Innovation Index 2025
WIPO_GII_2025.note: 139 economies; Taiwan is not covered and therefore uses a separate proxy.

WIPO_SOFTWARE_2025.title: WIPO GII indicator 6.2.3 — Software spending, % GDP (underlying year 2024; S&P Global)
used_for: reported software spending intensity where available
WIPO_SOFTWARE_2025.note: Indicator may be modeled when direct sales data are unavailable; not imputed for missing markets and not forced into score.

GARTNER_IT_2026.title: Gartner worldwide IT spending forecast, 2026
GARTNER_IT_2026.note: Worldwide IT spending forecast about +14.2% in 2026 in the July 2026 update; European IT about +11% in 2026 in regional outlook.

WORLD_BANK_MVA.title: World Bank WDI — Manufacturing, value added (current US$)
WORLD_BANK_MVA.note: Latest available year differs by country; therefore treated as a proxy rather than a same-year exact measurement.
